result.title: Behind Video Generation: Observations and Insights on Multimodal Understanding from Kling
result.summary: Video generation has progressed from isolated clips to coherent short-form audiovisual sequences, and the bottleneck is shifting from rendering to semantic control. This report summarizes the observations and insights on multimodal understanding gained from successive generations of Kling. We argue that generation quality is the projection of multimodal understanding through the entire data--conditioning--alignment--evaluation chain, and we examine this chain module by module. Kling-MLLM, a shared multimodal foundation model that unifies image, video, audio, synchronized audio--video, and interleaved inputs, is specialized for each downstream module. Because a DiT is trained on far fewer training samples than a language model, we treat captioning as a semantic contract that maximizes description density, and extend it to reference-grounded captioning that makes reference bindings explicit. Prompt enhancement translates user intent into this caption distribution: basic PE is derived from captions of compelling videos and refined with text-level and generator-in-the-loop reinforcement learning, while agentic PE refines the story and retrieves compelling examples. We show that a reliable text encoder comes from perceptual training rather than from stronger language ability, and that candidates can be screened from text alone before end-to-end training. Reward modeling pairs a general reward model for explainable, localized critiques with a decision reward model for fast multidimensional scoring, treating perceptual bandwidth as a first-class design parameter. Finally, we review task-specific automatic evaluation, focusing on protocols that expose scoring shortcuts and help trace failures to their upstream source. We hope these lessons offer practical guidance for building the understanding stack behind controllable video generation.

AI.brief_summary: 该报告梳理 Kling 视频生成背后的多模态理解栈，提出生成质量是多模态理解经数据、条件、对齐、评估链条的投影，并逐模块介绍共享多模态基座 Kling-MLLM、以高描述密度为目标的 captioning 与参考绑定标注、prompt enhancement、文本编码器感知训练、双路奖励模型与自动评估协议。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文本身面向视频生成，但其「通用奖励模型给出可解释局部评价＋决策奖励模型快速多维打分」及「先用文本筛候选再端到端训练」的线索，可能可供核查 LVR 中监督质量、答案验证与贡献分配问题；captioning 作为语义契约的高密度描述要求也与视觉细节是否在内部状态中保留相关。
